story.title: Harvard study finds AI outperformed two human doctors on emergency room diagnoses
story.summary: A new Harvard University study tested large language models against real emergency room cases and found that at least one AI model was more accurate in its diagnoses than two human emergency physicians evaluated in the same scenarios. The research examined AI performance across a variety of medical contexts, not just ER diagnoses, and represents one of the most rigorous head-to-head comparisons of AI versus human clinical judgement to date. The findings are likely to intensify the debate over how and when AI should be integrated into frontline medical decision-making.
